Today’s failing approach: separate screening and interview systems
Challenge 1:
Separate task libraries
Your team has to reconcile screening results with a live interview that may assess different criteria.
Challenge 2:
Interviews outside the platform
A video call and a shared document can leave the hiring committee relying on brief notes about the candidate’s approach.
Challenge 3:
Different standards across teams
Hiring managers who use separate rubrics can reach different conclusions about comparable performance.
Connect screening to the live technical round
Codility Screen
handles the initial assessment
Codility Interview
supports the live round
Your engineering team can use a shared assessment method while choosing exercises suited to each role.
Reuse screening tasks in the interview
Tasks built for Screen also work in Interview.
Your hiring manager can follow up on an exercise the candidate already completed or use a task written for the role.
Engineers can build custom interview tasks through the task-builder Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector.
Your team defines the evaluation criteria before the session.

Run coding and system design in one workspace
Codility Interview runs the live interview. It can follow a Screen assessment, or your team can use it on its own.
The workspace is realistic, with native VS Code, a terminal, dependencies and autocomplete.
The whiteboard supports a system design discussion in the same session.
You can enable or disable the AI Assistant per assessment, allowing you to test engineers writing code with AI, the way the job is done today. When enabled, every candidate interaction is captured as reviewable AI activity.
You can assess the candidate’s code, AI usage and design reasoning without moving the session between tools.
Full evidence for the hiring committee
Codility Interview provides rubric scores against your criteria.
When configured, recording, transcript and playback let reviewers check the candidate’s reasoning when opinions differ.
Codility also provides validation documentation for procurement and legal review.

Compare platforms against your hiring process
When evaluating platforms, check these key requirements.
Task continuity
Confirm whether you can reuse an assessment exercise during the live round.
Scoring methodology
Request the task validation documentation and discuss adverse impact analysis for your hiring context.
Regional requirements
Confirm data residency, accessibility and connections to your applicant tracking system.
Frequently asked questions
A technical interview platform provides the workspace, tasks and evaluation tools for assessing engineering candidates. Codility Interview supports the live round and connects to Codility Screen for asynchronous assessment.
A realistic coding environment, shared assessment criteria and reviewable evidence are the core requirements, including the ability to use AI where required to reflect today’s engineering reality. Evaluate the platform with a role your team is hiring for, then review the resulting candidate record with your interviewers.
Codility supports shared tasks and evaluation criteria across teams. Codility is WCAG 2.2 AA accessible and offers EU or US data hosting.
